objective: Add a sitemap.xml to the Lucky Nail Spa static site covering index.html and services.html, using the site's canonical domain (derive it from robots.txt / vercel.json / existing markup — do not invent one), and add the Sitemap: line to robots.txt. Validation: sitemap.xml is valid XML with absolute URLs on the canonical domain; robots.txt references it; no other files change.
validation_plan: python -c "import xml.dom.minidom as m; m.parse('sitemap.xml'); print('XML OK')"

python -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ns='{http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9}'; locs=[e.text for e in ET.parse('sitemap.xml').getroot().iter(ns+'loc')]; print(locs); assert len(locs)==2 and all(u.startswith('https://www.luckynailspadurham.com/') for u in locs); print('LOCS OK')"
